rounds.text: Likhami Consulting Ltd trades at an astronomical P/E ratio of 1294x based on filed statements [E1], which is further corroborated by data provider metrics placing the P/E at an extreme 1717.39x against a sector benchmark of just 233.23x [E6]. This lofty valuation is completely detached from the company's negligible profitability, demonstrated by a dismal return on equity of just 0.51% [E9], a meager ROE of 0.7% [E13], and a trivial ROCE of 0.9% [E12]. This chronically poor capital efficiency is not a temporary blip, as evidenced by a 10-year median ROE of 0% [E25] and a 5-year median ROE stuck at 1% [E26], which rightly triggers official negative flags for low return on equity [E57]. Investors are paying a steep price-to-book multiple of 8.47x according to filed statements [E2]—rising to 11.19x by alternative key ratios against a sector benchmark of 2.58x [E7]—for a business that offers a 0.00% dividend yield [E4]. Conceded: the company achieves a positive ROA of 0.65% that slightly outperforms the sector benchmark of -2.24% [E8].

Likhami Consulting Ltd presents a valuation profile that is detached from its underlying operational performance. The company trades at an extreme P/E ratio of 1294x [E1], which is significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 233.23x [E6]. This premium pricing is further underscored by a price-to-book ratio of 11.19x, dwarfing the sector benchmark of 2.58x [E7]. Investors are paying these elevated multiples despite a consistent history of negligible profitability, evidenced by a 10-year median return on equity of 0% [E25] and a current ROCE of only 0.9% [E12]. Furthermore, the lack of a dividend yield provides no income incentive to offset the risk of holding a stock currently trading near the bottom of its 52-week range [E4, E5]. Conceded: the company maintains a ROA of 0.65% and an ROE of 0.51%, both of which outperform the negative sector benchmarks [E8, E9].
